Hi Ava —

Thanks for signing up for Redwood Inference. We’re excited to show how Redwood can make LLM inference predictable and cost-effective for BrightLoop.ai.

Quick next step: pick a 30-minute slot that works for your team using this scheduling link: https://cal.com/redwood/quickpass/30min?cid=brightloop-0227

What to expect in the session
- 20 min demo tailored to your use case (inference cost/latency trade-offs, deployment modes)
- 10 min Q&A and next steps

Prep (optional): Attachments below include a short trial checklist and a one-page intro deck to help your team gather any access details.
Attachments: trial-checklist.pdf (PDF, 1 page) | redwood-intro-deck.pdf (PDF, 6 slides)

If you need a different time or have compliance questions ahead of the call, reply to this thread and an SDR will follow up.

— Redwood Inference Onboarding Team
